messages:
ana (Marketing): Quick sync — SRE says service is healthy. We need: 1) Status page short line, 2) embargoed email subject + 2-line body for affected customers, 3) one-line tweet (hold until Monitoring). Can someone propose wording? @sam @dave

sam (SRE): Timeline: degraded inference for subset of requests 03:40–04:02 UTC, rollback at 03:58, healthy at 04:02. Cause: autoscaler config triggered excessive batching. Monitoring in progress; full postmortem in 72h.

dave (Support): I'll compile impacted-account CSV and prepare canned replies. ETA 18m. For email include instructions to retry and how to send request IDs.

ana (Marketing): Draft A (statuspage short):
`Partial degradation affecting a subset of API requests from 03:40 to 04:02 UTC. Rollback applied; systems are healthy and under monitoring. Follow-up to come.`

Draft B (statuspage concise):
`Service degradation 03:40–04:02 UTC affecting a subset of requests. Rollback completed; monitoring ongoing.`

ana (Marketing): Embargoed email subject/body (hold send until support uploads CSV + legal ok):
Subject: Update: brief service degradation resolved

Hi —
We experienced degraded performance impacting some API requests between 03:40 and 04:02 UTC. A rollback resolved the issue and systems are healthy. If you saw errors, please reply with request IDs or open a ticket at support@redwood.ai. We will publish a full incident report within 72 hours.

sam (SRE): Quick check: no signs of data access in logs so far. I can confirm "no indication of customer data exposure at this time" in ~10m after full scan.

lee (Legal): Good — please wait for Sam confirmation before including the data sentence. Use careful phrasing until then.

maya (Growth): For lead routing: tag any signups during the window with "inc-5244" and route demos to on-call AEs. Also add a CRM note: "signup during incident — follow up w/ empathy".

dave (Support): CSV will be uploaded to /shared/incidents/inc-5244.csv in ~18m. I'll ping when ready.

statusbot: Incident INC-5244 updated: state=identified, severity=low. (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5244)

ana (Marketing): Plan recap: 1) Post Identified update on StatusPage using Draft A now. 2) Hold targeted email until CSV + legal confirmation. 3) Tweet only after Monitoring. 4) Postmortem + report within 72h. Any objections?

sam (SRE): +1

dave (Support): +1

lee (Legal): +1 pending data sentence confirmation

maya (Growth): +1 — will prep CRM tags
